Due to terrain restrictions, no direct route exists between Zone Alpha and Zone Beta. Moreover, owing to seasonal access limitations, the monitoring circuit must incorporate exactly one of the following two critical corridors: the path between Zone Beta and Zone Gamma, or the path between Zone Gamma and Zone Delta.

The objective is to determine the minimal total travel distance for a closed-circuit inspection tour that visits every habitat zone exactly once and returns to the origin.
